verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows team/user permissions and 'fine-grained permissions' for human access to data. These are adjacent controls and do not show issuable, scoped API keys or tokens for agents. No public API spec was found either (all OpenAPI probes returned 404).
